jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

As a Business Operations Manager/Senior Manager, you’ll be part of a small, high-leverage team responsible for tackling Zip’s most important business challenges. You’ll lead cross-functional initiatives, design and operationalize new processes, and work directly with senior leadership to drive measurable impact. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership and visibility, ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants accountability for delivering outcomes.

 
 


YOU WILL

 - Lead “zero-to-one” strategic initiatives across the organization, translating ambiguous goals into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.

 - Take ownership of projects end-to-end, from scoping and analysis through execution and implementation.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer, Product, and G&A teams to deliver operational improvements and inform strategic decision-making.

 - Build scalable processes and systems from “one-to-ten” and improve existing workflows for efficiency and growth.

 - Analyze business performance, develop robust models, and synthesize insights into clear recommendations for leadership.

 - Define success metrics, track performance, and ensure accountability across key initiatives.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6+ years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or business operations at a high-growth startup.

 - 4-year undergraduate degree (preferably in a quantitative or analytical field such as Business, Economics, Engineering, Finance, or related)

 - Proven ability to independently problem-solve and drive complex projects under ambiguity

 - Strong analytical skills, including experience working with complex business data

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to influence across levels and functions

 - Demonstrated ability to create and operationalize new processes, systems, or programs.
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Based in SF or willing to relocate; hybrid role.

 - Experience at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

 - Familiarity with internal AI tooling such as Claude Cowork

 - Prior exposure to both Product and GTM organizations.

 - MBA or advanced degree a plus but not required.

 

The salary range for this role is $150,000–$210,000 OTE. Final compensation is determined based on job-related factors including experience, skills, and location.

 
 


PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

 - 🍽️ Catered lunches & dinners for SF employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

 - 💸 401k plan



We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Operations Manager, Pre-Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.


YOUR ROLE

As a member of Zip’s GTM Strategy & Operations team, you’ll be a key partner to Solution Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and the broader executive team - driving strategic planning, operational execution, and analytical rigor across our revenue engine. This team sits at the intersection of go-to-market execution, company strategy, and systems - giving you a unique seat at the table to shape the trajectory of the business.

You'll partner with Global Solutions Engineering leadership to bring structure to a fast-scaling SE org: standardizing how SEs engage across the deal cycle and driving the cross-functional collaboration with surrounding teams that makes that engagement work in practice.

You'll keep SE capability aligned to a fast-evolving product portfolio — shaping enablement and GTM strategy so a growing team can demo, scope, and defend what's shipping.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own SE operations for the org: Lead day-to-day operations and long-term planning — the capacity and coverage model, hiring and ramp planning against open headcount, comp plan design, metrics, reporting, and "whatever it takes."

 - Act as a strategic thought partner: Be the go-to partner for SE leadership and execs - whether it's solving complex problems, framing key decisions, or bringing structure to ambiguity.

 - Drive GTM cadence and accountability: Run the operating rhythm - owning coverage and staffing reviews, pipeline/deal reviews, QBRs, and leadership syncs. You'll push velocity, track outcomes, and ensure every meeting drives impact.

 - Lead cross-functional execution: Work across SE, Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, and Finance to drive strategic initiatives forward - bringing a GTM perspective to company-wide efforts and ensuring alignment across teams.

 - Build with data: Use SQL, spreadsheets, and BI tools to structure analysis, validate  assumptions, and uncover insights that improve GTM execution and drive growth.

 - Own special projects: From coverage model design to GTM enablement to redefining our POC motion - you’ll own critical, high-impact workstreams that move the business forward.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, presales/solutions engineering operations, consulting, investing, or a similar high-performance environment.

 - Strong analytical and modeling skills - you're fluent in Excel/Sheets and can write SQL or are willing to learn.

 - Deep understanding of GTM motions and technical sales cycles, with battle-tested views on SE coverage ratios, POC/technical win rates, demo environment strategy, and capacity planning.

 - Experience working closely with GTM systems like Salesforce, Gong, and PreSales platforms

 - Excellent written and verbal communication - you can structure thinking clearly, write concise memos, and present to executives with confidence.

 - Attention to detail - you go deep on problems, sweat the edge cases, and set the quality bar high.

 - High bias for action - you move fast, think in tradeoffs, and find a way forward when others see blockers.

 - Technically inclined — you're not afraid of Salesforce Flows, brittle validation rules, or stitching together data across systems.

 - A collaborative mindset — you're opinionated but open to all perspectives, and you know how to drive alignment across stakeholders.

 - A proven operator — you've managed large, ambiguous projects that required both strategic thinking and tactical execution.

The salary range for this role is $153,000 - $189,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

jobs.title: Senior Order to Cash Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

As a Senior Order to Cash (OTC) Operations Manager at Zip, you will own and scale the end-to-end OTC function for recurring subscriptions and consumption revenue models. You will lead cross-functional initiatives and work directly with senior leadership to drive operational transformation, optimize cash flow, and build OTC system architecture for Zip’s future growth. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with broad exposure across Finance, Sales, Deal Desk, Product, and Engineering. The ideal candidate is an experienced operator and strong day-to-day executor who would rather build than maintain, and who is comfortable designing and deploying automation and AI tools to support Zip’s revenue growth.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the order to cash lifecycle end to end, from order creation through invoicing, collections, and cash application, ensuring accuracy, timely delivery, and adherence to contractual terms.

 - Drive customer collections: oversee dunning processes, monitor AR aging, and conduct direct outreach to customers with past-due accounts, working with Sales and Customer Success to resolve disputes and escalations.

 - Lead new billing and revenue system implementations, driving accounting requirements and keeping cross-functional stakeholders aligned on scope and timing.

 - Identify and deploy automation and AI-based workflows across invoicing and collections to reduce process cycle times.

 - Collaborate with GTM, Deal Desk, and Product on new SKU launches and validate that billing and accounting systems are ready before the launch date.

 - Manage the month-end close for bookings and billings, working in lockstep with Deal Strategy and Operations teams to ensure seamless handoff to Revenue Accounting.

 - Partner with Engineering and Product to ensure usage data is captured and reported into our billing systems accurately.

 - Proactively monitor and implement strategies to maintain strong collections, optimize cash flow and minimize bad debt exposure.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for AR and billing external audit matters.

 - Develop documentation, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the order-to-cash function.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Required

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. CPA is a plus.

 - 8+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, revenue accounting, or order-to-cash, including time at a high-growth technology company.

 - Experience managing hybrid revenue models (recurring subscription + consumption).

 - Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for reconciliation and data analysis.

 - Familiarity using Snowflake queries for data retrieval and analysis; SQL proficiency is a plus.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Working knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and application to billing.

 - Experience building AI-driven workflows involving multiple data sources and/or multiple system integration points.

 - Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work while owning strategic initiatives.

 - Track record of building or overhauling finance processes and systems, with sound judgment on what to build now and what to defer.

 - Familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, and modern billing and collections tooling.



The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $210,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

 


PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈  Start-up equity

 - 🦷  100% health, vision & dental coverage options

 - 🍽️  Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner 

 - 🌴  Flexible PTO

 - 🏋️‍♀️  ClassPass membership

 - 🚍  Monthly commuter benefit

 - 🚠  Team building events & happy hours

 - 💻  Home office stipend

 - 🛜  Phone/internet reimbursement

 - 🍼  Paid parental leave 

 - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒  Fertility stipend

 - 💸  401k plan

 - 🤖  Unlimited AI token usage
   
   

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a Strategic Finance Associate / Sr. Associate to join our growing Strategic Finance team, with a focus on Product finance. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders to shape the financial strategy of our business. You will build and maintain financial models, develop KPI frameworks, and deliver insights that influence product investments and growth priorities.

You'll also be a core finance partner on Zip's AI strategy, from how we price and package to how we forecast AI revenue and the inference costs that come with it.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll play a critical part in connecting product strategy with financial outcomes, supporting long-range planning, and influencing decisions at the executive and board level.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and manage the financial models that support our annual plan, long-range forecast, and multi-product growth strategy

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders to set topline targets, evaluate roadmap investments, and align on strategic priorities across the business

 - Model the financial impact of Zip's AI products and decisions, including pricing scenarios, unit economics, gross margin, and investment cases for new capabilities

 - Create and maintain KPI frameworks that track product performance and sales efficiency, giving leadership a holistic view of the business to guide resource allocation

 - Support executive decision-making by preparing high-quality board materials, investor updates, and leadership presentations

 - Drive company-wide forecasting and reporting processes across revenue, expenses, headcount, cash flow, and retention metrics




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 2+ years of private equity, investment banking, or similar experience

 - Experience in strategic finance at a high-growth technology company is a plus

 - Familiarity with technology, SaaS, and usage-based business models
